apptek.name: AppTek Call-Center Dialogues
apptek.attribution: AppTek, Call-Center Dialogues (2026); role-played customer-service recordings.
apptek.referenceProduction: Manually transcribed verbatim, diarized turn-level references.

monsoon.name: Monsoon en-IN public test
monsoon.referenceProduction: ASR drafts corrected and independently checked by native-speaking linguists.

edacc.name: EdAcc
edacc.referenceProduction: Professionally transcribed speaker turns with disfluencies and non-speech annotations.

notsofar.name: NOTSOFAR-1 eval-small with GT
notsofar.referenceProduction: Speaker-labelled, time-aligned human GT; lexical text is published transcription with non-speech tags removed.

dipco.name: DiPCo S06 eval
dipco.attribution: DiPCo corpus, Dinner Party Corpus; huckiyang/DiPCo mirror.
dipco.referenceProduction: Manual close-talk-derived speaker transcripts, timestamped JSON. Inference uses only distant U04 CH1.

ami.name: AMI ES2004a official manual annotations
ami.attribution: AMI Corpus, University of Edinburgh; official AMI download, CC BY 4.0.
ami.referenceProduction: AMI manually transcribed orthographic word XML with word timestamps, speaker and original punctuation.

earnings25.name: Earnings25 segmented Q4 2025
earnings25.licence: CC BY 4.0 transcripts/metadata; recording redistribution unclear
earnings25.attribution: Florence Jiang et al., Earnings25 (2026), Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.18762167.
earnings25.referenceProduction: Existing earnings-call transcripts paired to corporate audio with CTC forced alignment. Original transcriber and human review unreported; NOT Formatting gold.

rev16.name: Rev16 verbatim podcast episodes
rev16.licence: CC BY-SA 4.0 text only; podcast audio rights unclear
rev16.attribution: Radford et al. (2023), Rev transcriptionists; underlying podcast creators retain media rights.
rev16.referenceProduction: Professional human verbatim Rev transcription; case, punctuation and fillers reconstructed solely from nlp token columns. Parakeet used only for cut times, never text.

rev-earnings.name: Earnings-22/21 Rev verbatim
rev-earnings.licence: CC BY-SA 4.0 text only; audio rights unclear
rev-earnings.attribution: Rev, Earnings-22 and Earnings-21 human verbatim transcripts.
rev-earnings.referenceProduction: Professional Rev verbatim transcription; case, prepunctuation and punctuation are original token columns; aligned timestamps never supply text.

librispeech-pc.name: LibriSpeech-PC test-other
librispeech-pc.attribution: Mehri et al., LibriSpeech-PC; LibriSpeech / OpenSLR 12 audio.
librispeech-pc.referenceProduction: Printed source-book text aligned by researchers to LibriSpeech; text_raw keeps original orthography, text is ASR-normalized.

fleurs.name: FLEURS
fleurs.attribution: Conneau et al., FLEURS: Few-shot Learning Evaluation of Universal Representations of Speech (2022), Google.
fleurs.referenceProduction: FLoRes-101 sentences (human-written/translated prose) read aloud; raw_transcription keeps the written case and punctuation.

polish-tedx.name: Polish TEDx ASR Eval
polish-tedx.attribution: s512757, Polish TEDx ASR Eval (2026); original TEDx Talks speakers/video owners.
polish-tedx.referenceProduction: Student-transcribed TEDx talks; only rows with verified_by populated have evidenced second-annotator verification. Raw text preserved.

mls.name: Multilingual LibriSpeech
mls.attribution: Pratap et al., MLS (2020); source LibriVox readers and works.
mls.referenceProduction: Aligned audiobook text; test transcripts were human-listened and corrected.

muscat.name: MUSCAT evaluation
muscat.attribution: MUSCAT authors, bilingual scientific conversations, LREC 2026; native speakers.
muscat.referenceProduction: Whisper first pass, corrected by speakers; manual segment boundaries and language IDs; one Owl device per spoken event.

mediaspeech.name: MediaSpeech (per-language HF mirror)
mediaspeech.licence: CC BY 4.0 dataset; original videos retain owners’ copyright
mediaspeech.attribution: Kolobov et al., MediaSpeech (2021); original YouTube video owners. HF mirror ymoslem/MediaSpeech.
mediaspeech.referenceProduction: Two manual annotators and third disagreement resolver; postprocessed lexical sentences. HF mirror strips original video/channel identifiers.

klang.name: Klang Dialects sv-clean
klang.attribution: Klang AI, Klang Dialects (2026); opt-in Swedish speakers.
klang.referenceProduction: Prompts compared with audio; ASR ensemble/alignment and partial human correction; clean subset excludes ambiguous references.

aishell4.name: AISHELL-4 test (utterance mirror)
aishell4.attribution: AISHELL-4, Beijing Shell Shell Technology Co., Ltd.; OpenSLR SLR111; utterance files redistributed by shenyunhang/AISHELL-4.
aishell4.referenceProduction: Human TextGrid meeting annotation; first annotated speaker tier only; silence markup removed.

zeroth.name: Zeroth-Korean official test
zeroth.attribution: Zeroth-Korean, OpenSLR SLR40; test-only parquet redistributed by kresnik/zeroth_korean.
zeroth.referenceProduction: Published official read-speech transcript, unpunctuated Korean orthography.

hike.name: HiKE Korean–English code-switching test
hike.attribution: HiKE, thetaone-ai; bilingual speakers recorded reviewed, scripted Korean–English sentences.
hike.referenceProduction: Published punctuated text and separately supplied lexical text_normalized; no independent spontaneous transcript.
